messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The brands of bupropion are FDA-approved for specific conditions.
Wellbutrin SR is used to treat major depressive disorder.
Wellbutrin XL is used to treat MDD and seasonal affective disorder (SAD).
Aplenzin is used to treat MDD and SAD.
Zyban (discontinued) was used to help stop smoking.
Auvelity (bupropion with dextromethorphan) is used to treat MDD in adults.
Contrave (bupropion and naltrexone) is used for weight management for specific patients.
The information on this page is only about bupropion.
It is not about bupropion with dextromethorphan (Auvelity).
It is not about bupropion with naltrexone (Contrave).
Triplet: ["this page", "is not about", "bupropion with dextromethorphan"]

The relation 'is not about' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject information page does not cover the drug combination specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not caused by': The subject medical condition is not associated with the cause specified by the object entity.
B. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
C. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
E. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
